description: Odwieczny Dab, an eternal oak as old as the world, come alive: a colossal ancient oak tree giant, a massive gnarled trunk of dark brown bark with deep furrows, a wise ancient face in the bark with a long beard of green moss and glowing green eyes, a huge wide crown of golden and deep green oak leaves, glowing golden-green veins of light running through its bark, a soft primeval golden glow shining from its crown, two massive bough arms, thick roots for legs, majestic and protective, not menacing, full body, three-quarter view facing right, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole tree inside the picture, nothing cut off at the edges
